title: IREN Stock Rises 20.0% After Fiscal Q1 Results (Nov 6)
summary: IREN stock closed at $21.64 on Nov 6, up 20.02%, after fiscal Q1 results showed AI cloud revenue nearly tripling to $200 million.
body_markdown:
## Why IREN Stock Rose


According to the company's[Q1 FY27 results filed with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001878848/000187884826000065/irenreportsq1-fy27result.htm) on November 5, revenue for the quarter ended September 30 rose to $228 million from $137 million in the prior quarter, while AI Cloud revenue climbed to $200 million from $71 million. Bitcoin mining revenue fell to $28 million from $67 million, adjusted EBITDA improved to $66 million and the net loss narrowed to $263 million from $684 million. Revenue backlog grew 22% to $20.3 billion.


"AI Cloud revenue nearly tripled to $200 million, and operating ARR doubled to a billion," Co-Founder and Co-CEO Daniel Roberts said in the release. He added that since quarter-end IREN signed a five-year contract with 90% of the GPU capex prepaid by the customer.


As reported by[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/06/stock-market-today-nov-6-iren-soars-20-on-strong-ai-cloud-revenue-growth/) , the results beat expectations and helped ease concerns about neocloud stocks, which had been under pressure during the week over data center growth. Per[The Edge Malaysia](https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/824779) , shares had closed down about 17% on November 5 in a[broader selloff in chipmakers and neocloud companies](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nasdaq-record-point-loss-ai-stock-rout-wipes-25-trillion-us-futures-mixed-before-payrolls/) , before the results were released.


## IREN Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- About two-thirds of the $20.3 billion backlog is tied to investment-grade counterparties, and the company lists contracts with Nvidia, Microsoft and 13 other customers, according to the release.
- Contracted pricing continues to rise, by 11% on 3-year deals and 12% on 5-year deals, while AI Cloud gross margin held at 86%, the company said.
- Horizon 1 went into service for Microsoft during the quarter, according to Roberts.


### Risks


- The more than $4 billion annualized run-rate revenue target moved from year-end to January 2027 after a customer-requested design change and supplier timing, and it may extend to the end of February, the company said.
- IREN plans $15 billion of remaining FY27 capital expenditure, of which about $6 billion is targeted from other sources, subject to market conditions.
- The[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) still showed a quarterly net loss of $263 million.
- Bloomberg News, as cited by The Edge Malaysia, reported that Microsoft is tightening oversight of some neocloud-run data center projects, including IREN's, amid delays and rising costs.
